paper_title: Constraining the photon coupling of ultra-light dark-matter axion-like particles by polarization variations of parsec-scale jets in active galaxies
suggested_experiment_name: MOJAVE VLBA polarization observations of AGN jets
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper constrains axion-photon coupling g_agamma via non-observation of periodic polarization angle oscillations in parsec-scale AGN jets. The limit is approximately flat at ~10^-12 GeV^-1 across the mass range 5×10^-23 to 1.2×10^-21 eV. The bound assumes a dark matter density of ρ_DM ~ 20 GeV/cm^3 in elliptical galaxy centers (κ=1); limits scale as κ^(1/2). Data extracted from abstract and Section 5 results.
